scope: Bounded engineered physical-screen search; conditional inherited costs, no economic optimum.
signed_margin_definition: Authored predicate lhs-rhs for >= or >; rhs-lhs for <= or <. Positive means inside the authored comparison. Units are the authored operands; equality needs exact operator verdict.
break_even_equation: (LCOE_base-LCOE_N)*8760*net_MW_N*availability_N; exact matched input pairs only. Equivalent annual omitted-cost budget, never an installed quote.
